AgentOutputSchema

schema.description:
One declared input edge on a swarm member: a peer agent's or a tool's output.

The dependency's result is injected into the member's task as labelled context under
`arg_name` before the member runs. `kind='agent'` names another member in the same
roster; `kind='tool'` names an invocation-local tool the run carries.

kind.description: What kind of producer feeds this.
kind.title: Kind

name.description: Roster agent name, or invocation-local tool id, that produces the value.
name.title: Name

arg_name.description: Label the produced value is injected under in the member task context.
arg_name.title: Arg Name

schema.title: AgentPeerDependency

schema.description:
A tool argument that is satisfied by delegating to another agent.

The declaring tool never receives this argument from the model - the model is not even
shown it. The server runs the named agent, and binds its result to `arg_name` before the
tool executes.

tool_id.description: Tool whose argument this dependency fills.
tool_id.title: Tool Id

agent_name.description: Agent to delegate to, named in this run agents list.
agent_name.title: Agent Name

arg_name.description: Argument on the tool that receives the delegated agent result.
arg_name.title: Arg Name

optional.description: Whether the declaring tool marked this argument optional. An optional dependency is presented to the model as a boolean toggle and delegated only when the model asks; a required one always delegates.
optional.title: Optional

schema.description:
An algorithm-tagged fingerprint of one runnable definition.

Tagged rather than a bare string so the algorithm can change without every
agent silently appearing to drift: a digest computed under a different
algorithm is recognisably different rather than merely unequal.

algorithm.description: Fingerprint algorithm. Covers instructions, model settings and tools.
algorithm.title: Algorithm

value.description: Lowercase hex digest. Opaque to the platform, which compares it and can never resolve it back to a definition.
value.title: Value

schema.title: ServedAgent

schema.description:
One running process announcing the version it serves.

The display fields are a deliberately small, explicitly chosen subset: a
name, a description, and tool *names*. Not tool schemas, not instructions,
not model settings - those are the definition, and the whole point is that
the platform does not hold it. Anything added here should be justified as
something a person needs to read in Studio.

definition_digest.description: Fingerprint of the runnable definition, for drift detection only.

tool_names.description: Tool names for display. Never schemas - those are definition material.
tool_names.title: Tool Names

endpoint_url.description: HTTPS endpoint for webhook transport; absent for worker transport.
endpoint_url.title: Endpoint Url

sdk_version.description: SDK version of the announcing process, for support and compatibility.
sdk_version.title: Sdk Version
